title: Runner link as part of the application
summary: The SSH reverse tunnel between the Windows control plane and agent-runner-01 is today an operations script outside the product: a scheduled task that nothing in Studio observes, supervises, or can restart. Evidence from six outages (August stalls, 05.08. sleep outage, the disabled keeper task on 02.09. that Ready reported as a missing Codex sign-in), the failure classes, requirements for a link the application owns, four options, a two-stage recommendation (LinkSupervisor inside the Task Server process now, tunnel retired with the remote Task Server in Phase B), the LinkSupervisor design, the programme table, and three decisions.
statusReason: D1 was delivered by AGT-2763; AGT-2764 remains blocked because Stable has no configured RunnerLinks resource and the required seven-day adoption soak has not started. D2 and D3 remain open and are carried by AGT-W49 and AGT-W57 section 6.

review.note: AGT-2763 delivered LinkSupervisor, but AGT-2764 is blocked before the adoption soak; AGT-W49 owns the target operations boundary and AGT-W57 section 6 preserves the open migration dependency.
